description: PHASE 1 (branch feat/frontend-v2-scaffold): Astro + Tailwind scaffold in a NEW folder Public/frontend-v2/, coexisting with the untouched Public/frontend/. Establishes the static build, dark/light theme system (in the header alongside year + language), i18n dictionary + language toggle, the env/config module for the four PUBLIC_* URLs with fallbacks, and a minimal Home so a Vercel build succeeds. Self-contained; adds NO dependency to mgmt/* or Public/frontend/.
steps: Create Public/frontend-v2/package.json: name chhath-public-frontend-v2, private true, type module, scripts { dev: 'astro dev', build: 'astro build', preview: 'astro preview', check: 'astro check', test: 'node --test test/*.test.mjs' }. Pin current stable versions of the real deps: astro (^4.x), @astrojs/tailwind (^5.x), tailwindcss (^3.4.x). Do NOT invent packages. Ensure valid JSON.

Create Public/frontend-v2/astro.config.mjs: import defineConfig from 'astro/config' and tailwind from '@astrojs/tailwind'; export defineConfig({ output: 'static', integrations: [tailwind()], site derived from the config module's PUBLIC_SITE_URL fallback }). Keep it a plain .mjs that passes `node --check` (import of astro/@astrojs is fine for --check since it only parses, does not resolve).

Create Public/frontend-v2/tailwind.config.mjs (or .cjs): darkMode: 'class' (class strategy is REQUIRED for the toggle), content globs ['./src/**/*.{astro,html,js,jsx,ts,tsx,md,mdx}'], theme.extend with a saffron brand palette matching the current portal accent (#F27A1A primary; include success #10B981, danger #EF4444, warning #F59E0B) and the Inter font family. Valid JS, passes node --check.

Create the env/config module Public/frontend-v2/src/config.js (framework-free, importable by both Astro and node:test): export apiBase, renderChatUrl, mgmtLoginUrl, siteUrl. Each reads import.meta.env.PUBLIC_* with a sensible FALLBACK default (apiBase 'https://chhath-public-worker.shaharpura.com', renderChatUrl 'https://chhath-server-render.onrender.com/public-chat', mgmtLoginUrl 'https://mgmt-chhath.shaharpura.com/', siteUrl 'https://chhath.shaharpura.com'). Guard `typeof import.meta !== 'undefined' && import.meta.env` so the module also loads under plain node:test (where import.meta.env is undefined) and returns the fallbacks. Export a pure helper resolveConfig(env) that takes an env-like object and applies the fallbacks, so it can be unit-tested directly. Document each var in a top comment in the project's WHY-style.

Create Public/frontend-v2/src/i18n.js (framework-free): port the T dictionary (T.en and T.hi) VERBATIM from Public/frontend/script.js (~lines 130-190), plus pure functions t(lang, key) (fall back to en then the key) and localize(row, field, lang) (prefer '<field> (Hindi)' when lang==='hi', fall back to English). Export LANG_KEY constant matching current behavior semantics (a v2-specific localStorage key, e.g. 'cpm_public_v2_lang').

Create Public/frontend-v2/src/layouts/Layout.astro: base HTML shell. In <head> include the no-flash inline theme script (reads localStorage 'theme' else prefers-color-scheme, sets/removes 'dark' class on <html> BEFORE first paint), Inter + Material Icons font links (non-render-blocking media=print onload swap pattern like current index.html), and a slot for per-page head. Body renders the Header island and a <slot/>. Wire Tailwind base via the global stylesheet import.
Create Public/frontend-v2/src/styles/global.css with Tailwind @tailwind base/components/utilities and any small custom layer (e.g. brand CSS vars) so components can use dark: variants.

Create Public/frontend-v2/src/components/Header.astro (or an interactive island, e.g. a small <script> in the component): logo + bilingual title, desktop nav + mobile bottom-nav placeholders, and the THREE controls grouped TOGETHER in the header per the user's explicit instruction — LANGUAGE toggle, YEAR dropdown, and the THEME (dark/light) toggle side by side. The theme toggle flips the 'dark' class on <html> and persists to localStorage 'theme'; the language toggle flips lang and persists to the i18n LANG_KEY and re-applies data-i18n text; year dropdown is a placeholder select (populated with data in Phase 2). Use the ported i18n for labels.

Create Public/frontend-v2/src/pages/index.astro: a minimal but real, responsive, theme- and i18n-aware Home using Layout + Header so `astro build` produces a valid page (full data wiring lands in Phase 2). Include a hero placeholder.

Create Public/frontend-v2/test/config.test.mjs and test/i18n.test.mjs using node:test: assert resolveConfig applies fallbacks when env keys are missing and honors provided PUBLIC_* values; assert t() falls back en->key and localize() prefers the Hindi column and falls back to English. Do NOT import Astro.

Verify: `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check` on config.js, i18n.js, astro.config.mjs, tailwind.config.mjs, and both test files; confirm package.json/tsconfig.json parse as JSON; run `cd Public/frontend-v2 && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --test test/*.test.mjs` green. Confirm nothing outside Public/frontend-v2/ changed.
acceptance_criteria: Public/frontend-v2/ contains a self-contained Astro+Tailwind project: package.json, astro.config.mjs (output static), tailwind.config with darkMode 'class', tsconfig.json, .gitignore, src/config.js, src/i18n.js, src/layouts/Layout.astro, src/styles/global.css, src/components/Header.astro, src/pages/index.astro.
The header contains all THREE controls together: language toggle, year dropdown, and theme (dark/light) toggle.
Theme system uses class strategy with a no-flash inline head script (localStorage + prefers-color-scheme) and persists the choice.
None of the four URLs are hardcoded in components; they come from src/config.js via import.meta.env.PUBLIC_* with documented fallbacks.
`env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check` passes on every authored .mjs/.js; package.json and tsconfig.json are valid JSON.
`cd Public/frontend-v2 && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --test test/*.test.mjs` passes.
No file outside Public/frontend-v2/ is modified (Public/frontend/ and mgmt/* untouched).
verification: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check Public/frontend-v2/src/config.js && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check Public/frontend-v2/src/i18n.js && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check Public/frontend-v2/astro.config.mjs && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check Public/frontend-v2/tailwind.config.mjs
cd Public/frontend-v2 && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --test test/*.test.mjs
git status --porcelain | grep -v 'Public/frontend-v2/' | grep -v '.agents/' (expect no other modified files)
findings: Scaffolded self-contained Astro+Tailwind project under Public/frontend-v2/ (12 files): package.json (astro ^4.16.18, @astrojs/tailwind ^5.1.2, tailwindcss ^3.4.15), astro.config.mjs (output 'static', tailwind integration, site from config), tailwind.config.mjs (darkMode 'class' + saffron brand ramp with #F27A1A primary, success/danger/warning, Inter font), tsconfig.json (extends astro/tsconfigs/strict), .gitignore, src/config.js (env resolver + resolveConfig helper + eager named exports, guarded for node:test), src/i18n.js (T.en/T.hi ported verbatim, t()/localize()/normalizeLang, LANG_KEY 'cpm_public_v2_lang'), src/styles/global.css, src/layouts/Layout.astro (no-flash inline theme script + non-render-blocking fonts + env-driven SEO), src/components/Header.astro (three grouped controls: language toggle, year dropdown placeholder, theme toggle; inline client script uses define:vars for T/LANG_KEY so no dict duplication; mgmt login link uses env-driven mgmtLoginUrl), src/pages/index.astro (responsive theme/i18n-aware hero). VERIFIED: `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check` green on config.js, i18n.js, astro.config.mjs, tailwind.config.mjs and both test files; package.json/tsconfig.json parse as JSON; `node --test test/*.test.mjs` = 15 pass / 0 fail; git status confirms only Public/frontend-v2/ added, nothing else outside .agents/ touched. NOT VERIFIED IN-SANDBOX (expected/accepted): `npm install` and `astro build` are blocked by INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode (403), so the actual Astro build runs on Vercel. No hardcoded URLs in components; all four come from src/config.js via import.meta.env.PUBLIC_* with fallbacks.
